title.en: An Act Declaring September One of Every Year, the Death Anniversary of Gregorio Aglipay Y Labayan, as Gregorio L. Aglipay Day and a Special Non-Working Holiday in the Municipality of Batac, Province of Ilocos Norte
title.orig: An Act Declaring September One of Every Year, the Death Anniversary of Gregorio Aglipay Y Labayan, as Gregorio L. Aglipay Day and a Special Non-Working Holiday in the Municipality of Batac, Province of Ilocos Norte

text.en: The first day of the month of September of every year, being the death anniversary of Gregorio L. Aglipay y Labayan, is hereby declared as Gregorio L. Aglipay Day and a special non-working holiday in the Municipality of Batac, Province of Ilocos Norte.
Any provision of law, decree, order, rules or regulations inconsistent with this Act is hereby repealed and/or modified accordingly.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
